items.title: How Many Shares of McDonald’s, Starbucks or Darden Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, $1,000 a month in dividends takes about $424,900 of McDonald’s stock, about $418,100 of Darden Restaurants or about $491,100 of Starbucks. McDonald’s paid out 70% of its free cash flow as dividends over the last 12 months, and analysts expect 69% for fiscal 2026.
